sources.title: VERINA
sources.evidence: Section 3.1 defines positive/negative input-output tests; do not infer that the theorem-proving language cannot encode heaps.

sources.title: COINS
sources.evidence: Instantiates specifications over trusted cases into Rocq proof obligations; successful proofs provide evidence and failed proofs are ambiguous.

sources.title: SpecRL
sources.evidence: Sections 3.3.2-3.3.5 construct a runtime-checkable SpecCheck predicate and mutate return values after materializing program side effects. Auxiliary annotations are generated and verifier-checked. Do not claim no arrays or no side effects.

sources.title: Code-Specify-Test-Debug-Prove
sources.evidence: User-provided PDF section 5.2 (p. 16) supports runtime loop-invariant and lemma checks. Section 6 (p. 18) explains take bindings as computable resource outputs and ghost arguments as explicit quantifier instantiation. Latest artifact README section numbers and reported bug counts differ; preserve version provenance.

sources.title: Computing Correctly with Inductive Relations (PLDI 2022)
sources.evidence: QuickChick derives semi-decision procedures, enumerators and generators with correctness proofs for a class of first-order inductive relations; do not claim it only accepts handwritten Boolean properties. Discuss in related work, not the direct C heap baseline experiment.
